thread:
Michelle: Quick design review — model catalog rows: the pin CTA/top-right feels hidden when badges are present. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.dev/ux/pin-screenshot.png
Raj: I saw that — pin icon gets lost next to performance badge. Maybe move it into row actions overflow?
Sam: moving to overflow hides discoverability. Could we add a subtle "Pin" label for hover and tooltips?
Aisha: Accessibility: the pin button needs aria-pressed and keyboard focus ring. Also contrast of badge bg is low on #f2f4f6.
Sam: +1. Proposed aria: ```<button aria-pressed="false" aria-label="Pin model version" class="pin-btn">📌</button>```
Michelle: Love that. Microcopy tweak: change "Pin" -> "Pin version" or "Keep version"? Which reads better in a compact UI?
Raj: "Pin version" is clearer. "Keep version" ambiguous.
Aisha: Keyboard: Suggest kbd shortcut "P" when row focused. Add aria-keyshortcuts="p". Also need focus order doc.
Sam: Also suggest persistent indicator when a version is pinned (thin left stripe) so density stays compact.
Michelle: Design nit: when multiple badges show (perf/quantized/stable) we should prioritize badge order: performance > stability > quantization. That keeps critical info first.
Raj: Could we add a11y label for the badge group: ```<div role="group" aria-label="Model flags: performance, stable">...``` so screen readers read them as a block.
design-bot: Visual diff uploaded: https://redwood-ci.com/diffs/98321 — highlights pin contrast change.
Michelle: Ok action items: 1) Sam to update ARIA & tooltip copy; 2) Aisha to draft keyboard flow + a11y testcases; 3) Raj to prototype stripe indicator; 4) I'll update badge ordering and microcopy. Deadline EOD Fri.
Sam: Will do. :thumbsup:
Aisha: I'll add tests to axe + keyboard nav.
Raj: Prototyping in Figma, will share link when ready.
Michelle: Thanks all — quick sync tomorrow if anything blocks. :coffee:
